title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…

The air feels heavy. The beauty of the garden is still around me… but something has changed. Adam and Eve stand ahead, trembling beneath the weight of what has just happened. Judgment has been spoken. Consequences are unfolding.
And then—within the warning… a promise.

I stand quietly, hardly breathing, as God speaks of a future offspring… One who will crush the serpent’s head, though His heel will be struck. In the middle of loss, I sense something unexpected—hope beginning to breathe again.
Even here. Even now. Redemption is whispered into the dust of humanity’s first failure.
I am only a witness, not a biblical character… but as I watch, I realize this promise stretches forward—beyond the garden… beyond generations… toward the cross.

What does it mean that God’s first response to sin included redemption?
What does this tell us about His heart?
💭 Share what this moment makes you feel.
